macro.name: Logic.OneOffI18N.TrueRemark
macro.description: Bilingual authored explanation for the logic library.

en.body: The inductive proposition #0 has the constructor True.intro, so #0 has a proof without assumptions. This alone does not prove an arbitrary proposition. Its recursor admits singleton elimination into Sort u.

zh-CN.body: 归纳命题 #0 具有构造子 True.intro，因此无需假设即可证明 #0；仅凭此不能证明任意命题。它的递归子允许单构造子消去到 Sort u。
